title: The coord hook tells a session and its operator who else works on the same items or files, in what run state, and the suggested way to coordinate
goal: the coord hook posts each intent with the touch field its items' item files list (whole paths only, as many as fit the field's 120 characters), so an intent carries its items' touches; at a SessionStart the hook finds each other live session whose items or touches meet this session's and shows it; at a backlog.py claim the hook does the same for the claimed item and its touches; at a Bash or Skill event, the first one at once and then at most every 10 seconds, the hook does the same when announce.when names midrun; at PreToolUse on Edit or Write of a file inside another live item's touches the hook does the same when announce.when names edit, registered in .claude/settings.json for Edit and Write; the start and claim moments are on by default as kbsettings sets them and a moment announce.when leaves out stays silent; each overlap is shown once, as systemMessage to the operator and additionalContext to Claude; the message names the other session by its label (s- and six hex characters of its id, never the raw id) with its operator id, its item id with the title its item file gives in this workspace, its run state with its age, plus the files the two share; the message gives the strategy the settings suggest for that run state with its command (wait: coord.py wait --kind progress --item ID / ask: kbask.py ask / after: backlog.py set --add-depends / join / proceed) plus the others; with strategy.decide operator (the default) the message tells Claude that the operator decides and to tell the operator and ask which; with strategy.decide claude the message tells Claude to follow the suggestion and say what it did; the hook reads announce and strategy from kbsettings.effective for the workspace of the event's cwd; the hook never blocks a tool call and stays within its 10 second budget

gates.question: What identifies an overlap so the coord hook shows it once?
options: one overlap per other session and its items, whatever its run state
one overlap per other session, its items and its run state, so a move of the state shows again
gates.recommendation: one overlap per other session and its items, whatever its run state

gates.question: Where does the age of a run state in the overlap come from?
options: coord.py digest gains age= on an intent line, the seconds since the newest progress event that moved its items
the hook asks coord.py wait for the item's progress events and reads their times
gates.recommendation: coord.py digest gains age= on an intent line, the seconds since the newest progress event that moved its items

gates.question: How does the overlap map a run state to a strategy key and word the strategies' commands?
options: claimed and working use strategy.working, returned, staging, failed and refused use strategy.returned, a state none is known uses working; wait is coord.py wait --kind progress --item ID --since 0 --timeout 600, ask targets the other item id, join and proceed are words
only working, landing, blocked and returned map, any other state or none is left to strategy.decide
gates.recommendation: claimed and working use strategy.working, returned, staging, failed and refused use strategy.returned, a state none is known uses working; wait is coord.py wait --kind progress --item ID --since 0 --timeout 600, ask targets the other item id, join and proceed are words
